description: This file defines the Coocook::Controller::Email package, which manages email-related actions such as notifications, password changes, recovery links, and verification URLs within a web application. It uses Moose for object orientation and extends a base controller, implementing various private methods to prepare email data and URLs.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Email
classes.description: Controller class handling email-related actions and email content preparation.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Initializes the email view and sets the email signature if configured.

methods.name: notify_admin_about_registration
methods.description: Prepares email data to notify an admin about a new user registration, including anonymized email.

methods.name: password_changed
methods.description: Prepares email data to notify a user about a password change, including recovery URL.

methods.name: recovery_link
methods.description: Prepares email data with a recovery link for password reset, including expiration info.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Prepares email data for user email verification, including verification URL.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Sets the default 'from' address for outgoing emails.
